requiredExports.syntxSecretSource: (credentials, token) -> redaction source for error results
requiredExports.uploadSyntxReference: ({ token, credentials, secrets, bytes, filename, mimeType, signal, options }) -> { success, url } or error result
requiredExports.runSyntxMediaJob: ({ scope: "image", route: "design", chatField: "chat_uuid", modality: "image", kindHint: "image", aiName, prompt, settings, inputUrls, token, credentials, secrets, signal, options }) -> { success, media, accounting } or error result with acceptedJob after submit

exports.syntxMusicAdapter: default music adapter: generate({ model, body, credentials, signal, log })
exports.syntxSttAdapter: default STT adapter: transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal, log })
exports.createSyntx{Image,Video,Tts,Music,Stt}Ad: factories; options { fetchImpl, now, wait, timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, requestTimeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, uploadTimeoutMs, transcribeTimeoutMs, download: { fetchImpl, lookup, timeoutMs, maxBytes } } for tests
exports.resolveSyntxModel: (model, kind) -> exact catalog row or null

exports.downloadSyntxMedia / syntxPublicUrl / as: result URL policy and guarded download

exports.syntxAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost

auth.kind: SYNTX.ai site JWT (unofficial web session token)
auth.fieldOrder: accessToken, apiKey, providerSpecificData; the first JWT-shaped value wins
auth.validation: eyJ prefix, three base64url parts, at most 16 KiB; otherwise 401 before any request
auth.sourceCredentialUi: webSessionCredentials.ts syntx: kind token, storageKeys token/apiKey/accessToken
auth.accountScope: only the selected connection's fields; egress through that connection's proxy options; no shared cache or environment fallback
auth.downloads: never carry the JWT, cookies or any credential, to any host

models.selection: exact ai_name/model_type ids from the source seed catalog for the requested kind (optional syntx/ or stx/ prefix); a bare model_type or ai_name only when it names exactly one row of that kind; no default model, no passthrough
models.dynamicDiscovery: not staged: the source's GET /api/v1/ai and /api/v1/ai/models live catalog is not ported, so ids outside the seed are refused

generate.body: { chat_uuid (chat_id for video), prompt, settings, file_urls?, audio_url? }

poll.ready: latest author_id -1 message with every message_object completed

transcribe.answer: text, data.text, or a plain-text body

noReplay: chat creation and uploads bill nothing and are not retried; generate and transcribe are sent once. Any failure after they may have reached SYNTX carries acceptedJob (jobState submit-unknown, accepted, cancelled, poll-lost or poll-timeout) and must stop account fallback for that request.
errors: never quote the upstream body; only HTTP status and a bounded Retry-After on 429; credential values redacted through createErrorResult
quota: none flagged: the source maps no SYNTX quota condition. 402 stays a plain 402; 429 is a rate limit with header-only reset evidence.
accounting: mediaAccounting(null, "syntx", modality) with unknown cost; image nativeUnits.images from returned items; video nativeUnits.videos 1; speech characters added by ttsCore; meta.chatId
